newTells.label: new:every-section-in-card
newTells.definition: Every section sits in its own identical rounded bordered card.

newTells.label: new:raised-breadcrumb-chips
newTells.definition: Breadcrumb or tab items are drawn as raised, shadowed button chips.

newTells.label: new:duplicated-information
newTells.definition: The same fact (count, name, date) is shown twice on the screen.

newTells.label: new:misaligned-element
newTells.definition: An element sits out of alignment with its neighbours.

newTells.label: new:sparse-dead-space
newTells.definition: Most of the page is left empty, with sparse content.

newTells.label: new:stock-sample-names
newTells.definition: Stock or invented sample organisation and people names (Northwind, Acme).

newTells.label: new:rainbow-colour-coding
newTells.definition: Avatars or pills are given many arbitrary hues, one per item or status.

newTells.label: new:dotted-pastel-status-pills
newTells.definition: Status shown as tinted pills with a leading coloured dot.

newTells.label: new:clipped-content
newTells.definition: Text, columns or labels are cut off or overflow their container.

newTells.label: new:generic-subtitle
newTells.definition: A generic subtitle restates the page title or task.

newTells.label: new:inconsistent-component-styles
newTells.definition: One instance of a component is styled unlike its siblings or the rest of the UI.

newTells.label: new:unexplained-empty-gap
newTells.definition: A large unexplained gap separates related elements.

newTells.label: new:letter-logo-tile
newTells.definition: The logo is a small square tile with a letter or monogram.

newTells.label: new:page-in-single-card
newTells.definition: The whole page's content is wrapped in one large card.

newTells.label: new:washed-out-disabled-button
newTells.definition: The disabled primary button is a faded, washed-out tint.

newTells.label: new:helper-text-every-field
newTells.definition: Every field has helper text beneath it.

newTells.label: new:keyboard-shortcut-hint
newTells.definition: A "/" keyboard shortcut hint sits in the search field.

newTells.label: new:label-value-grid
newTells.definition: Metadata laid out as a uniform grid of grey labels over values.

newTells.label: new:awkward-text-wrap
newTells.definition: Labels or names wrap awkwardly in narrow cells.

newTells.label: new:dark-mode-toggle
newTells.definition: A dark-mode button or moon icon sits in the header.

newTells.label: new:stock-screen-archetype
newTells.definition: The screen follows a textbook template archetype (settings form, projects table, KPI dashboard).

newTells.label: new:gradient-logo-mark
newTells.definition: The logo is a gradient-filled square mark.

newTells.label: new:glossy-raised-button
newTells.definition: A button is drawn glossy and raised with a heavy bottom shadow or gradient.

newTells.label: new:stray-focus-outline
newTells.definition: A focus ring is drawn around a non-input element such as the page title or main region.

newTells.label: new:monochrome-no-accent
newTells.definition: The interface is black, white and grey with no accent colour.

newTells.label: new:status-hierarchy-by-fill
newTells.definition: Status pills differ by solid, outlined or plain fill to show rank.

newTells.label: new:pastel-tag-chips
newTells.definition: Roles, tags or allergens shown as tinted or outlined pill chips.

newTells.label: new:avatar-stack
newTells.definition: An overlapping stack of avatar circles with a +N count.

newTells.label: new:literal-icon-logo
newTells.definition: The logo is a literal stock icon of the domain (truck, paw, brush).

newTells.label: new:raw-float-in-copy
newTells.definition: An unrounded floating-point number (28.000000000000004) appears in the interface.

newTells.label: new:sample-data-label
newTells.definition: A "Sample data" pill badge is shown in the header.

newTells.label: new:understated-stats
newTells.definition: Stat tiles use small, restrained values rather than hero numbers.

newTells.label: new:diverse-name-roster
newTells.definition: Sample people form a deliberately diverse roster of names.

newTells.label: new:inset-shadowed-field
newTells.definition: An input is drawn inset with a grey inner shadow, often reading as disabled.

newTells.label: new:links-everywhere
newTells.definition: Every email, phone or value is rendered as an underlined link.

newTells.label: new:card-footer-action-bar
newTells.definition: A card ends in a grey footer bar holding Cancel and Save.

newTells.label: new:generic-product-name
newTells.definition: An invented, generic or cute product name (Relay, PawBook).

newTells.label: new:serif-display-headings
newTells.definition: Headings are set in a serif display face.

newTells.label: new:sort-arrows-every-column
newTells.definition: Every column header carries a sort arrow.

newTells.label: new:consistent-outline-icons
newTells.definition: One outline icon set is used consistently, e.g. beside each detail or in the nav.

newTells.label: new:diff-chips
newTells.definition: A change log shows old and new values as strikethrough-to-new chips.

newTells.label: new:progress-bar-every-row
newTells.definition: Every table row carries a progress bar with a percentage.

newTells.label: new:rendering-artifacts
newTells.definition: Chart marks render with jagged or broken edges.

newTells.label: new:smoothed-chart-lines
newTells.definition: Line charts use smoothed spline curves between points.

newTells.label: new:sync-status-shown
newTells.definition: A "Last synced/Updated" time is shown, often with a Refresh button.

newTells.label: new:two-line-cells
newTells.definition: Table cells carry a grey secondary line under the main value.

newTells.label: new:chart-legend-mismatch
newTells.definition: The legend or labels don't match the marks drawn (missing series, unlabelled segment).

newTells.label: new:monospace-ids
newTells.definition: Reference IDs are set in a monospace face.

newTells.label: new:stray-separator
newTells.definition: A separator dot or bullet trails with nothing after it.

newTells.label: new:count-beside-search
newTells.definition: A result count is floated to the right of the search field.

newTells.label: new:hairline-row-dividers
newTells.definition: Thin hairline rules separate every row of a list.

newTells.label: new:inconsistent-capitalisation
newTells.definition: The same kind of label is capitalised differently from item to item.

newTells.label: new:placeholder-contact-details
newTells.definition: Contact details use placeholder values such as 555 phone numbers.

newTells.label: new:stock-status-set
newTells.definition: Statuses use the stock On track / At risk / Off track set.

newTells.label: new:unequal-card-heights
newTells.definition: Side-by-side cards have mismatched heights.

newTells.label: new:awkward-number-format
newTells.definition: Numbers are formatted inconsistently or with redundant decimals.

newTells.label: new:chart-event-annotation
newTells.definition: An event is annotated on the chart with a band or marker line.

newTells.label: new:selected-state-heavy-border
newTells.definition: The selected card is marked by a heavy or coloured border.

newTells.label: new:dot-separated-meta
newTells.definition: Metadata items run in a row separated by middle dots.

newTells.label: new:gradient-area-fill
newTells.definition: A line chart has a soft gradient or tinted fill beneath the line.

newTells.label: new:oversized-numbers
newTells.definition: A stat or hero number is set very large.

newTells.label: new:nested-containers
newTells.definition: A table sits in a bordered box inside another card or container.

newTells.label: new:segmented-controls
newTells.definition: Options are switched with segmented pill controls.

newTells.label: new:chart-table-toggle
newTells.definition: A Chart/Table toggle offers the data as a table.

newTells.label: new:delta-indicators
newTells.definition: Values carry green/red up/down triangles or arrows for change.

newTells.label: new:filter-toolbar
newTells.definition: A toolbar of filter pills and selects sits above the content.

newTells.label: new:red-overdue-flag
newTells.definition: Late or overdue values are flagged in red text.

newTells.label: new:relative-timestamps
newTells.definition: Times are shown relatively ("2 hours ago").

newTells.label: new:centred-fixed-container
newTells.definition: Content sits in a narrow centred fixed-width column.

newTells.label: new:checkbox-column
newTells.definition: Tables lead with a row-selection checkbox column.

newTells.label: new:cramped-spacing
newTells.definition: Elements are squeezed with too little space between them.

newTells.label: new:domain-inconsistency
newTells.definition: Sample content contradicts itself within the domain (e.g. a braised dish on the grill station).

newTells.label: new:minimal-chrome
newTells.definition: Plain pale page with no sidebar and little surrounding interface chrome.

newTells.label: new:prose-chart-summary
newTells.definition: A caption or subtitle restates the chart's figures in words.

newTells.label: new:purposeful-helper-copy
newTells.definition: Helper copy explains consequences or context specific to the task.

newTells.label: new:sentence-status-line
newTells.definition: A result count is written as a full sentence with a full stop.

newTells.label: new:truncated-axis
newTells.definition: The y-axis starts above zero, exaggerating change.

newTells.label: new:ellipsis-placeholder
newTells.definition: A search field's placeholder text ends in an ellipsis.

newTells.label: new:eyebrow-label
newTells.definition: A small label sits above the page title.

newTells.label: new:ranked-bar-list
newTells.definition: A tidy list of horizontal bars ranks items.

newTells.label: new:takeaway-chart-title
newTells.definition: The chart title states the finding as a sentence.

newTells.label: new:too-tidy-data
newTells.definition: Sample data is suspiciously regular: sequential IDs and uniformly plausible values.

newTells.label: new:card-header-dividers
newTells.definition: Cards have a rule separating the card title from its body.

newTells.label: new:direct-line-labels
newTells.definition: Series are labelled at the line ends instead of with a legend.

newTells.label: new:domain-expert-copy
newTells.definition: Copy uses accurate, specialist domain detail (temperatures, techniques, regional spelling).

newTells.label: new:em-dash-copy
newTells.definition: Em dashes appear in names or interface strings.

newTells.label: new:pill-nav
newTells.definition: Top navigation items are rendered as pills.

newTells.label: new:primary-secondary-button-pair
newTells.definition: A filled primary button sits beside a bordered secondary button.

newTells.label: new:broken-images
newTells.definition: Small images or icons fail to load and render as dots or blanks.

newTells.label: new:cover-photo-profile
newTells.definition: A profile page with a landscape cover photo and overlapping round avatar.

newTells.label: new:crowded-axis-labels
newTells.definition: An axis labels every tick so the labels crowd each other.

newTells.label: new:dated-sample-data
newTells.definition: Sample data is visibly old (e.g. 2018 crypto prices, 2014 filenames).

newTells.label: new:dated-template-look
newTells.definition: The styling reads as an older (2014-era) flat admin template.

newTells.label: new:debug-control-exposed
newTells.definition: A developer/demo control (e.g. "Make the next change fail") is left in the product UI.

newTells.label: new:disabled-until-valid
newTells.definition: The primary action stays disabled until the form is filled in.

newTells.label: new:domain-specific-structure
newTells.definition: Content is structured the way the domain works (e.g. ingredients grouped by stage, quantity-first).

newTells.label: new:edge-case-handling
newTells.definition: The screen shows copy or states for edge cases (e.g. the sole owner cannot change role).

newTells.label: new:export-option
newTells.definition: An Export CSV or similar data-download control sits beside the chart.

newTells.label: new:file-type-icons
newTells.definition: Files are listed with per-type document icons.

newTells.label: new:fully-ruled-table
newTells.definition: A table with borders on every cell.

newTells.label: new:headline-not-shown-in-chart
newTells.definition: The headline names an event that the chart does not mark.

newTells.label: new:identical-placeholder-rows
newTells.definition: Table rows repeat identical placeholder values (same date, same status, '#' index).

newTells.label: new:locale-number-format
newTells.definition: Numbers use a non-local format such as $1.800,00.

newTells.label: new:muted-comparison-series
newTells.definition: A prior period is drawn as a muted grey line against an accented current series.

newTells.label: new:no-cards
newTells.definition: Content sits flat on the page without card containers.

newTells.label: new:odd-copy
newTells.definition: A heading or label uses unusual or awkward wording.

newTells.label: new:overlapping-text
newTells.definition: Two lines of text are drawn on top of each other.

newTells.label: new:plain-line-chart
newTells.definition: A simple single-line chart without decoration.

newTells.label: new:quirky-sample-data
newTells.definition: Sample data includes quirky or joke names and odd values.

newTells.label: new:radio-with-descriptions
newTells.definition: Radio options each carry a descriptive helper line.

newTells.label: new:raised-tactile-style
newTells.definition: Controls are drawn raised or bevelled, like physical keys.

newTells.label: new:raw-data-leak
newTells.definition: Raw data values (e.g. a sparkline's number list) render as visible text.

newTells.label: new:real-photo-avatars
newTells.definition: Avatars are real photographs of people.

newTells.label: new:restrained-palette
newTells.definition: A muted palette with one or two colours and no decoration.

newTells.label: new:save-status-indicator
newTells.definition: A small "Saved" chip sits beside the primary action.

newTells.label: new:single-chart-focus
newTells.definition: One chart carries the whole page instead of a row of KPI cards.

newTells.label: new:small-radius-flat-cards
newTells.definition: Cards have a small radius, thin borders and no soft shadow.

newTells.label: new:social-media-widgets
newTells.definition: Social follow buttons and circular social-network icons.

newTells.label: new:sortable-columns
newTells.definition: A table column header carries a sort control.

newTells.label: new:source-sans-type
newTells.definition: The interface is set in Source Sans.

newTells.label: new:sparse-axis-ticks
newTells.definition: The x-axis shows only a few ticks (e.g. quarterly) instead of every period.

newTells.label: new:template-sample-copy
newTells.definition: Lorem/hipster ipsum or template demo copy is left in.

newTells.label: new:text-link-tabs
newTells.definition: Section navigation is plain underlined text links.

newTells.label: new:two-column-form-layout
newTells.definition: A form or editor on the left with a narrow details column on the right.

newTells.label: new:unlabelled-axis
newTells.definition: A chart axis carries no value labels.

newTells.label: new:zebra-striped-table
newTells.definition: Table rows alternate background shades.
